prefs.notes: All global settings (name kept from X1 BOX, which hakuX forks). Does not exist before the app is first opened (until then the data dir holds only cache/ and code_cache/). Read at each game launch: NativeCoreActivity turns them into core arguments (scale=, aspect=, fxaa=, upscale=, video=<bitmask>, avpack=, lang=, asyncpipe=, prebuild=, net=). SharedPreferences are cached in the app process; force-stop before editing. Create only after the app has made the file once (first-run setup also stores setup_complete, gamesFolderUri, hddUri).

per_game_prefs.notes: Per-game overrides, all stored as <string> values. Absent on a fresh install.

gpu_driver.notes: One installed custom Vulkan driver (folder with meta.json + the .so named by libraryName); installed from zips in /sdcard/Android/data/com.rfandango.haku_x/files/gpu_drivers/ through the UI. Not a setting key.

per_game.game_id: '<TITLEID>.<version>' with the title ID as 8 uppercase hex digits and the XBE version in decimal, e.g. 4D530004.9 (format %08X.%d from the disc's default.xbe certificate). The bundled mods folders use the same ids (assets/mods/4D530004.9 = Halo 2). Discs without a readable id use 'path:<relative path>'; the dashboard uses its own fixed id.
per_game.notes: Key = '{game}/<setting>' where <setting> is: uncapped, render_scale, async_shaders, prebuild_shaders, console_timing, aspect, fxaa, upscale, language, screen_format, 480p, 720p, 1080i, pal60, av_pack. All values are strings: "true"/"false" for switches, "2" for render_scale, the same option words as the global keys otherwise. Missing key = global value. Older builds keyed by title ID only ('<TITLEID>/<setting>'); the app migrates those to the versioned key on read. Not tested: needs a game added first.

resolution_scale.label: Settings > Resolution scale
resolution_scale.notes: Stored as <int>. Passed to the core as scale=N at launch. Per game: string "N" under <TITLEID>.<ver>/render_scale.

uncapped_fps.label: Settings > Uncapped frame rate

values.true: Present every frame at once (no vsync wait)

uncapped_fps.notes: Core arg 'uncap'. Per-game setting name: uncapped.

values.\"auto\": Auto (game's own; 16:9 when the console is widescreen)

prebuild_shaders.label: Settings > Build cached shaders before starting

show_fps.label: Settings > Show FPS counter
show_fps.notes: Read when the game activity resumes.

values.true: Emulate disc/HDD read time (as games expect)

screen_format.label: Console video > Screen format
screen_format.notes: The Xbox dashboard's own video setting (games that support widescreen use it). Per-game name: screen_format.

language.label: Settings > Language

values.\"auto\": Auto (phone language if supported, else English)

language.notes: Passed as lang=<index+1>. Per-game name: language.

network.label: Network > Connection
network.notes: Values from the launch switch (string hash codes for 'kai' and 'lan' match). insignia adds net=nat and dns=network_insignia_dns (default 46.101.64.175); kai uses network_kai_engine; lan uses network_lan_peers.
